description_html:
The Vaporesso XROS 2 Pod Kit is a slim refillable pod system with adjustable airflow and dual activation for a versatile MTL vaping experience.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 800mAh
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL
  • Coil Type: Integrated Mesh
  • Coil Resistance: 0.8Ω (included)
  • Activation: Dual (Button + Draw-Activated)
  • Airflow: Adjustable
  • Display: 4-Stage LED Battery Indicator
  • Fill Method: Top Fill
  • Pod Compatibility: All Vaporesso XROS Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, 1.2Ω)
  • Brand: Vaporesso

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Forest Green, Gold, Grape Purple, Midnight Blue, Orange Red, Sakura Pink, Sierra Blue, Silver, Space Grey.
